physics.en: The laws of physics explain why objects fall towards the ground.
physics.zh: 物理定律解释了物体为什么会向地面坠落。

chemistry.en: Knowledge of chemistry helped early metal workers to produce stronger tools.
chemistry.zh: 化学知识帮助早期的金属工匠制造出更坚固的工具。

matter.en: Scientists believe that most matter in the universe cannot be seen directly.
matter.zh: 科学家认为,宇宙中的大部分物质无法直接观测。

matter.en: Small differences in temperature matter a great deal to these insects.
matter.zh: 微小的温差对这些昆虫来说很要紧。

substance.en: This substance becomes a liquid when it is heated above ninety degrees.
substance.zh: 这种物质加热到九十度以上就会变成液体。

particle.en: Tiny particles of dust in the air can damage the lungs.
particle.zh: 空气中的微小尘埃颗粒会损害肺部。

atom.en: Every atom of an element contains the same number of protons.
atom.zh: 同一种元素的每个原子含有相同数量的质子。

molecule.en: A water molecule consists of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.
molecule.zh: 一个水分子由两个氢原子和一个氧原子组成。

electron.en: An electron carries a negative charge and moves around the centre of an atom.
electron.zh: 电子带负电荷,围绕原子中心运动。

proton.en: A proton carries a positive charge and is found in the centre of an atom.
proton.zh: 质子带正电荷,位于原子中心。

neutron.en: A neutron has about the same mass as a proton but carries no charge.
neutron.zh: 中子的质量与质子大致相同,但不带电荷。

nucleus.en: The nucleus contains most of the mass of an atom.
nucleus.zh: 原子核包含了原子的大部分质量。

compound.en: Salt is a compound made from sodium and chlorine.
compound.zh: 盐是由钠和氯构成的化合物。

mixture.en: Air is a mixture of nitrogen, oxygen and several other gases.
mixture.zh: 空气是氮气、氧气和其他几种气体的混合物。

oxygen.en: Almost all animals need oxygen in order to produce energy.
oxygen.zh: 几乎所有动物都需要氧气来产生能量。

hydrogen.en: Hydrogen could become an important clean fuel for trucks and ships.
hydrogen.zh: 氢可能成为卡车和船舶的重要清洁燃料。

nitrogen.en: Certain plants add nitrogen to the soil and so improve its quality.
nitrogen.zh: 某些植物能给土壤增加氮,从而改善土质。

carbon.en: Trees store carbon in their wood as they grow.
carbon.zh: 树木在生长过程中把碳储存在木材里。

sodium.en: Too much sodium in the diet can lead to high blood pressure.
sodium.zh: 饮食中钠过多可能导致高血压。

calcium.en: Calcium is needed to build strong bones and teeth.
calcium.zh: 强健的骨骼和牙齿需要钙。

iron.en: Iron tools gradually replaced those made of softer metals.
iron.zh: 铁制工具逐渐取代了较软金属制成的工具。

copper.en: Copper is widely used in electrical wires because it conducts electricity well.
copper.zh: 铜导电性好,因此被广泛用于电线。

aluminium.en: Aluminium is light and strong, so it is widely used in aircraft.
aluminium.zh: 铝又轻又坚固,所以被广泛用于飞机。

alloy.en: Steel is an alloy of iron and a small amount of carbon.
alloy.zh: 钢是铁和少量碳的合金。

acid.en: Strong acid can burn the skin and damage most metals.
acid.zh: 强酸能灼伤皮肤,并损坏大多数金属。

alkaline.en: Plants of this kind grow best in alkaline soil rich in lime.
alkaline.zh: 这类植物最适合生长在富含石灰的碱性土壤中。

solution.en: The metal dissolves slowly when it is placed in a weak acid solution.
solution.zh: 把这种金属放入弱酸溶液中,它会慢慢溶解。

solution.en: Recycling alone is not a complete solution to the problem of waste.
solution.zh: 仅靠回收并不能彻底解决废物问题。

solvent.en: Water is an excellent solvent and can dissolve many different substances.
solvent.zh: 水是极好的溶剂,能溶解许多不同的物质。

vapour.en: Water vapour in the air turns into rain when it cools.
vapour.zh: 空气中的水蒸气冷却后变成雨。

evaporate.en: Water evaporates quickly from the surface of shallow lakes in summer.
evaporate.zh: 夏天,浅湖表面的水蒸发得很快。

condense.en: Warm air rises, cools and condenses to form clouds.
condense.zh: 暖空气上升、冷却后冷凝形成云。

freeze.en: Water expands when it freezes, and this can break even solid rock.
freeze.zh: 水结冰时会膨胀,甚至能使坚硬的岩石破裂。

melt.en: Rising temperatures are causing mountain glaciers to melt more quickly.
melt.zh: 气温上升导致山地冰川融化得更快。

boil.en: Water boils at a lower temperature at the top of a high mountain.
boil.zh: 在高山山顶,水的沸点较低。

reaction.en: The chemical reaction releases heat and produces a small amount of gas.
reaction.zh: 这个化学反应释放热量,并产生少量气体。

catalyst.en: The metal acts as a catalyst and speeds up the chemical process.
catalyst.zh: 这种金属起催化剂作用,加快了化学过程。

catalyst.en: The invention of printing was a catalyst for great social change.
catalyst.zh: 印刷术的发明促进了巨大的社会变革。

oxidation.en: Oxidation causes iron to rust when it is exposed to air and water.
oxidation.zh: 氧化使铁暴露在空气和水中时生锈。

combustion.en: The combustion of coal releases large quantities of carbon dioxide.
combustion.zh: 煤的燃烧释放大量二氧化碳。

toxic.en: Some factories have released toxic waste into nearby rivers.
toxic.zh: 一些工厂把有毒废物排入附近的河流。

radiation.en: Too much radiation from the sun can damage the skin.
radiation.zh: 过多的太阳辐射会损伤皮肤。

radioactive.en: Radioactive waste must be stored safely for thousands of years.
radioactive.zh: 放射性废物必须安全储存数千年。

nuclear.en: Nuclear power produces little carbon dioxide but creates dangerous waste.
nuclear.zh: 核能产生的二氧化碳很少,但会产生危险的废物。

energy.en: Plants store energy from the sun in the form of sugar.
energy.zh: 植物以糖的形式储存来自太阳的能量。

force.en: The force of the water gradually wore away the rock.
force.zh: 水流的力量逐渐磨蚀了岩石。

force.en: Rising sea levels may force people to leave their homes.
force.zh: 海平面上升可能迫使人们离开家园。

friction.en: Friction between the tyres and the road slows a car down.
friction.zh: 轮胎和路面之间的摩擦使汽车减速。

pressure.en: Water pressure increases rapidly as you go deeper into the ocean.
pressure.zh: 越往海洋深处,水压增加得越快。

velocity.en: The velocity of the river increases as it flows down the steep slope.
velocity.zh: 河水流下陡坡时,流速会增加。

acceleration.en: The acceleration of an object depends on the force acting on it.
acceleration.zh: 物体的加速度取决于作用在它上面的力。

momentum.en: A heavy ship has so much momentum that it takes a long time to stop.
momentum.zh: 大船的动量很大,需要很长时间才能停下来。

momentum.en: The campaign for cleaner air has gained momentum in recent years.
momentum.zh: 近年来,争取清洁空气的运动势头越来越强。

mass.en: The Sun contains almost all the mass of the solar system.
mass.zh: 太阳几乎占了太阳系的全部质量。

mass.en: Mass production made cars affordable for ordinary families.
mass.zh: 大规模生产让普通家庭也买得起汽车。

density.en: Ice floats on water because it has a lower density.
density.zh: 冰能浮在水面上,是因为它的密度较低。

magnetic.en: Some birds use the Earth's magnetic field to find their way.
magnetic.zh: 有些鸟利用地球磁场辨别方向。

magnet.en: A compass needle is a small magnet that points to the north.
magnet.zh: 指南针的指针是一块指向北方的小磁铁。

electricity.en: The country produces most of its electricity from hydropower.
electricity.zh: 这个国家的大部分电力来自水力发电。

electrical.en: Nerves send electrical signals from the brain to the rest of the body.
electrical.zh: 神经把电信号从大脑传到身体其他部位。

circuit.en: Electricity can flow only when the circuit is complete.
circuit.zh: 只有电路闭合时,电流才能流动。

voltage.en: High voltage power lines carry electricity over long distances.
voltage.zh: 高压输电线路进行远距离输电。

battery.en: Better battery technology has made electric cars far more practical.
battery.zh: 更好的电池技术让电动汽车实用多了。

conductor.en: Copper is a good conductor of both heat and electricity.
The conductor of the orchestra chose a programme of modern music.
conductor.zh: 乐团指挥选了一组现代音乐曲目。

insulation.en: Good insulation keeps heat inside the building during cold winters.
insulation.zh: 良好的隔热层能在寒冬把热量留在建筑内。

frequency.en: Bats can hear sounds at a frequency too high for humans.
frequency.zh: 蝙蝠能听到人类听不到的高频率声音。

wavelength.en: Red light has a longer wavelength than blue light.

spectrum.en: Rainbows show the full spectrum of colours found in sunlight.
spectrum.zh: 彩虹展现了阳光中完整的色彩光谱。

infrared.en: Infrared cameras can detect animals by the heat of their bodies.
infrared.zh: 红外线相机能通过动物的体温探测到它们。

ultraviolet.en: Ultraviolet light from the sun can cause skin cancer.
ultraviolet.zh: 来自太阳的紫外线可能导致皮肤癌。

laser.en: Surgeons now use a laser to correct many common eye problems.
laser.zh: 外科医生现在用激光矫正许多常见的眼部问题。

optical.en: Optical fibres carry information around the world at very high speed.
optical.zh: 光纤以极高的速度在全球传输信息。

lens.en: A lens bends light so that a telescope can show distant stars clearly.
lens.zh: 透镜使光线弯曲,让望远镜能清晰地显示遥远的恒星。

reflect.en: Snow and ice reflect most of the sunlight back into space.
reflect.zh: 冰雪把大部分阳光反射回太空。

reflect.en: The results reflect a general decline in the level of reading.
reflect.zh: 这些结果反映出阅读水平的普遍下降。

refract.en: Water droplets refract sunlight, and that is how a rainbow forms.
refract.zh: 水滴折射阳光,彩虹就是这样形成的。

absorb.en: Dark surfaces absorb more heat than light-coloured surfaces.
absorb.zh: 深色表面比浅色表面吸收更多热量。

emit.en: Power stations emit large amounts of carbon dioxide into the air.
emit.zh: 发电站向空气中排放大量二氧化碳。

fossil-fuel.en: Burning fossil fuels is the main source of greenhouse gases.
fossil-fuel.zh: 燃烧化石燃料是温室气体的主要来源。

coal.en: Coal was the main source of energy during the Industrial Revolution.
coal.zh: 煤炭是工业革命时期的主要能源。

petroleum.en: Plastic and many other everyday materials are made from petroleum.
petroleum.zh: 塑料和许多其他日常材料都是由石油制成的。

crude-oil.en: The price of crude oil rose sharply during the 1970s.
crude-oil.zh: 20 世纪 70 年代,原油价格急剧上涨。

natural-gas.en: Natural gas produces less carbon dioxide than coal when burned.
natural-gas.zh: 天然气燃烧时产生的二氧化碳比煤少。

renewable.en: Renewable sources now provide a third of the country's electricity.
renewable.zh: 可再生能源现在提供该国三分之一的电力。

solar-panel.en: Many homes now have a solar panel on the roof to reduce their bills.
solar-panel.zh: 现在许多家庭在屋顶安装太阳能电池板来减少电费。

wind-turbine.en: A single wind turbine can supply power to hundreds of homes.
wind-turbine.zh: 一台风力涡轮机能为数百户家庭供电。

hydroelectric.en: The hydroelectric dam provides most of the power used in the valley.
hydroelectric.zh: 这座水力发电站大坝提供了山谷大部分的用电。

geothermal.en: Geothermal plants use heat from deep underground to produce electricity.
geothermal.zh: 地热电站利用地下深处的热量发电。

biofuel.en: Biofuel made from food crops may push up the price of food.
biofuel.zh: 用粮食作物制成的生物燃料可能推高粮价。

generator.en: A small generator provides power for the village when the main supply fails.
generator.zh: 主电源中断时,一台小型发电机为村庄供电。

power-station.en: The old power station burned coal brought in by train.
power-station.zh: 这座旧发电站燃烧由火车运来的煤。

grid.en: Electricity from the wind farm is fed into the national grid.
grid.zh: 风电场发出的电被输入国家电网。

ion.en: An ion is an atom that has gained or lost an electron.
ion.zh: 离子是得到或失去电子的原子。

atomic.en: Atomic clocks can measure time with extraordinary accuracy.
atomic.zh: 原子钟能以极高的精度测量时间。

solubility.en: The solubility of salt increases as the water becomes warmer.
solubility.zh: 盐的溶解度随水温升高而增加。

dilute.en: Chemical waste is sometimes diluted with water before it is released.
dilute.zh: 化学废物有时在排放前用水稀释。

evaporation.en: Evaporation from the lake is highest during the hot summer months.
evaporation.zh: 湖水的蒸发量在炎热的夏季最高。

condensation.en: Condensation forms on cold windows when warm air touches the glass.
condensation.zh: 暖空气接触到冷玻璃时,窗户上就会产生冷凝水。

distillation.en: Fresh water can be produced from seawater by distillation.
distillation.zh: 淡水可以通过蒸馏从海水中制取。

dehydrate.en: Some desert animals can survive for weeks without water and rarely dehydrate.
dehydrate.zh: 一些沙漠动物可以数周不喝水,也很少脱水。

decomposition.en: Bacteria play a key role in the decomposition of dead plants.
decomposition.zh: 细菌在枯死植物的分解中起着关键作用。

fusion.en: The Sun produces its energy through the fusion of hydrogen atoms.
fusion.zh: 太阳通过氢原子聚变产生能量。

catalysis.en: Catalysis is used in the production of most modern chemicals.
catalysis.zh: 大多数现代化学品的生产都要用到催化作用。

polymer.en: Plastic is a polymer made up of long chains of smaller molecules.
polymer.zh: 塑料是由较小分子形成的长链构成的聚合物。

hydrocarbon.en: Oil and natural gas are both types of hydrocarbon found underground.
hydrocarbon.zh: 石油和天然气都是地下的碳氢化合物。

impurity.en: The filter removes almost every impurity from the drinking water.
impurity.zh: 过滤器几乎能除去饮用水中的所有杂质。

neutralise.en: Farmers add lime to neutralise the acid in their soil.
neutralise.zh: 农民加入石灰来中和土壤中的酸。

corrode.en: Salt in the air can corrode metal structures near the sea.
corrode.zh: 空气中的盐分会腐蚀海边的金属结构。

rot.en: Wet conditions cause wooden buildings to rot within a few decades.
rot.zh: 潮湿的环境使木制建筑在几十年内腐烂。

ignite.en: Dry leaves can easily ignite during the hot summer months.
ignite.zh: 在炎热的夏季,干枯的树叶很容易点燃。

explosive.en: The workers used explosives to cut the tunnel through the mountain.
explosive.zh: 工人们用炸药在山中开凿隧道。

explosive.en: Coal dust in the air can be highly explosive in a mine.
explosive.zh: 矿井中空气里的煤尘可能具有很强的爆炸性。

adhesive.en: The insect produces a natural adhesive that holds its eggs to leaves.
adhesive.zh: 这种昆虫分泌一种天然粘合剂,把卵粘在叶子上。

bleach.en: Bleach is sometimes used to remove the natural colour from paper.
bleach.zh: 漂白剂有时被用来去除纸张的天然颜色。

dye.en: The ancient dye was made from a type of small sea snail.
dye.zh: 这种古老的染料是由一种小海螺制成的。

dye.en: Local women dye the wool using plants collected from the hills.
dye.zh: 当地妇女用从山上采来的植物给羊毛染色。

foam.en: The new type of foam keeps the inside of the building warm.
foam.zh: 这种新型泡沫能使建筑内部保持温暖。

alchemy.en: Alchemy was the early attempt to change ordinary metals into gold.
alchemy.zh: 炼金术是早期把普通金属变成黄金的尝试。

zinc.en: Steel is often covered with a thin layer of zinc to prevent rust.
zinc.zh: 钢常覆盖一层薄薄的锌来防锈。

tin.en: Tin was traded across the ancient world because it was needed for bronze.
tin.zh: 锡在古代世界各地都有贸易,因为制造青铜需要它。

nickel.en: Nickel is added to steel to make it stronger and harder.
nickel.zh: 钢中加入镍可以使它更坚固、更硬。

platinum.en: Platinum is a rare metal used in car engines and jewellery.
platinum.zh: 铂是一种稀有金属,用于汽车发动机和珠宝。

helium.en: Helium is lighter than air and is often used in weather balloons.
helium.zh: 氦比空气轻,常用于气象气球。

ammonia.en: Ammonia is widely used in the production of farm fertilisers.
ammonia.zh: 氨被广泛用于生产农业化肥。

iodine.en: A lack of iodine in the diet can cause serious health problems.
iodine.zh: 饮食中缺碘可能引起严重的健康问题。

silicon.en: Most computer chips are made from silicon, which comes from sand.
silicon.zh: 大多数计算机芯片由来自沙子的硅制成。

sulphur.en: Burning coal releases sulphur, which can later fall as acid rain.
sulphur.zh: 燃煤释放硫,之后可能形成酸雨。

brass.en: Brass is a yellow metal made from a mixture of copper and zinc.
brass.zh: 黄铜是由铜和锌混合而成的黄色金属。

bronze.en: People began to use bronze tools about five thousand years ago.
bronze.zh: 人们大约在五千年前开始使用青铜工具。

gasoline.en: Electric cars are cheaper to run than cars powered by gasoline.
gasoline.zh: 电动汽车的运行成本比汽油车低。

centigrade.en: Water freezes at zero degrees centigrade and boils at one hundred.
centigrade.zh: 水在零摄氏度结冰,在一百摄氏度沸腾。

artificial.en: Artificial lighting allowed factories to continue working through the night.
artificial.zh: 人造照明让工厂能够彻夜运转。

brittle.en: Glass is hard but brittle, so it breaks easily when dropped.
brittle.zh: 玻璃坚硬但易碎,所以掉在地上很容易破。

elasticity.en: Skin loses some of its elasticity as people get older.
elasticity.zh: 随着年龄增长,皮肤会失去部分弹性。

attrition.en: Rocks in the river become smooth through attrition over long periods.
attrition.zh: 河里的石头经过长期磨损变得光滑。

vibration.en: Sensors can detect the slightest vibration in the walls of the bridge.
vibration.zh: 传感器能检测到桥壁最轻微的振动。

echo.en: Bats find their food by listening to the echo of their own calls.
echo.zh: 蝙蝠通过倾听自己叫声的回声来寻找食物。

acoustic.en: The acoustic qualities of the hall make it ideal for concerts.
acoustic.zh: 这个大厅的声学效果使它非常适合举办音乐会。

ultrasonic.en: Dolphins communicate using ultrasonic sounds that humans cannot hear.
ultrasonic.zh: 海豚用人类听不到的超声波交流。

mechanics.en: The laws of mechanics explain how forces affect moving objects.
mechanics.zh: 力学定律解释了力如何影响运动的物体。

dynamics.en: Researchers study the dynamics of the group to see how leaders emerge.
dynamics.zh: 研究者研究群体的动态,观察领导者是如何产生的。

thermodynamics.en: The laws of thermodynamics describe how heat moves between objects.
thermodynamics.zh: 热力学定律描述了热量如何在物体之间传递。

gravitation.en: Newton's law of gravitation explains the movement of the planets.
gravitation.zh: 牛顿的万有引力定律解释了行星的运动。

relativity.en: Einstein's theory of relativity changed our understanding of space and time.
relativity.zh: 爱因斯坦的相对论改变了我们对空间和时间的理解。

magnetism.en: Early sailors used magnetism to find their direction at sea.
magnetism.zh: 早期的水手利用磁性在海上辨别方向。

electromagnetism.en: Electromagnetism explains how electric motors turn electricity into movement.
electromagnetism.zh: 电磁学解释了电动机如何把电转化为运动。

electronics.en: Advances in electronics have made phones smaller and more powerful.
electronics.zh: 电子学的进步使手机更小、功能更强大。

semiconductor.en: Every modern computer depends on the semiconductor chips inside it.
semiconductor.zh: 每台现代计算机都依赖其内部的半导体芯片。

transistor.en: The transistor made it possible to build much smaller radios.
transistor.zh: 晶体管使制造小得多的收音机成为可能。

amplifier.en: An amplifier makes weak signals from the microphone much stronger.
amplifier.zh: 放大器把麦克风发出的微弱信号大大增强。

insulator.en: Rubber is a good insulator and is used to cover electrical wires.
insulator.zh: 橡胶是良好的绝缘体,被用来包裹电线。

optics.en: Advances in optics led to the development of better microscopes.
optics.zh: 光学的进步促成了更好的显微镜的发明。

ray.en: A ray of light bends as it passes from air into water.
ray.zh: 一束光从空气进入水中时会发生弯曲。

translucent.en: The insect's translucent wings allow some light to pass through.
translucent.zh: 这种昆虫半透明的翅膀能让部分光线透过。

opaque.en: The water became opaque because of the mud carried by the river.
opaque.zh: 由于河水带来的泥沙,水变得不透明了。

diffract.en: Waves diffract as they pass through a narrow opening in a sea wall.
diffract.zh: 波浪穿过海堤的狭窄开口时会发生衍射。

powder.en: The rock is crushed into a fine powder and mixed with water.
powder.zh: 岩石被碾成细粉,然后与水混合。

intensity.en: The intensity of the storm surprised even the weather forecasters.
intensity.zh: 这场风暴的强度甚至让天气预报员都感到意外。

crystal.en: Salt forms small crystals as the water around it evaporates.
crystal.zh: 周围的水蒸发时,盐形成小晶体。

fluid.en: The fluid inside the inner ear helps people to keep their balance.
fluid.zh: 内耳中的液体帮助人们保持平衡。

equilibrium.en: The lake reached an equilibrium between the water flowing in and out.
equilibrium.zh: 流入和流出的水量使湖泊达到了平衡。

bubble.en: Tiny bubbles of air trapped in the ice show what the ancient atmosphere was like.
bubble.zh: 困在冰中的微小气泡显示了古代大气的样子。

crude.en: Crude oil must be refined before it can be used as fuel.
crude.zh: 原油必须经过提炼才能用作燃料。

crude.en: Early astronomers could make only crude estimates of the distance to the Moon.
crude.zh: 早期的天文学家只能粗略估算到月球的距离。

dioxide.en: Sulphur dioxide from factories was a major cause of acid rain.
dioxide.zh: 工厂排放的二氧化硫是酸雨的主要成因。

swell.en: Wood tends to swell when it becomes wet, so doors may stick.
swell.zh: 木头受潮后容易膨胀,所以门可能卡住。

static.en: The figures remained static for ten years before beginning to rise.
static.zh: 这些数字十年间保持不变,之后才开始上升。

static.en: Rubbing a balloon on your hair produces static electricity.
static.zh: 用气球摩擦头发会产生静电。

synthesis.en: The synthesis of new materials has become an important area of research.
synthesis.zh: 新材料的合成已成为一个重要的研究领域。

residue.en: Pesticides can leave a harmful residue on fruit and vegetables.
residue.zh: 农药可能在水果和蔬菜上留下有害残留物。

absorption.en: Vitamin D helps with the absorption of calcium in the body.
absorption.zh: 维生素 D 有助于人体吸收钙。

thickness.en: The thickness of the ice is measured by satellites each year.
thickness.zh: 每年都用卫星测量冰的厚度。

synthetic.en: Synthetic fibres such as nylon are made from chemicals found in oil.
synthetic.zh: 尼龙等合成纤维由石油中的化学物质制成。

residual.en: Residual heat in the ground warms the plants through the night.
residual.zh: 地面的余热整夜为植物保温。

flux.en: The language is in a state of constant flux as new words appear.
flux.zh: 随着新词的出现,这种语言不断变化。

chloride.en: Sodium chloride is the chemical name for common salt.
chloride.zh: 氯化钠是食盐的化学名称。

potassium.en: Bananas are a good source of potassium, which is important for the heart.
potassium.zh: 香蕉是钾的良好来源,而钾对心脏很重要。

amplitude.en: The amplitude of a sound wave determines how loud the sound is.
amplitude.zh: 声波的振幅决定声音的大小。

diffusion.en: Gases spread through a room by the process of diffusion.
diffusion.zh: 气体通过扩散过程充满房间。

soluble.en: Sugar is soluble in water, but sand is not.
soluble.zh: 糖可溶于水,但沙子不能。

acidic.en: Water in the lake became more acidic after years of pollution.
acidic.zh: 多年污染后,湖水的酸性变强了。

oscillation.en: The regular oscillation of a pendulum was once used to keep time.
oscillation.zh: 钟摆有规律的摆动曾被用来计时。

deflection.en: The deflection of light by gravity was first measured in 1919.
deflection.zh: 引力使光线偏转的现象于 1919 年首次被测量到。

oxidise.en: Iron will oxidise quickly if it is left in wet conditions.
oxidise.zh: 铁放在潮湿环境中会很快氧化。

cyclic.en: The climate has gone through cyclic changes over thousands of years.
cyclic.zh: 数千年来,气候经历了周期性的变化。

steam.en: Early railways used steam to power their engines.
steam.zh: 早期的铁路用蒸汽为发动机提供动力。

flame.en: The colour of the flame shows how hot the fire is.
flame.zh: 火焰的颜色显示出火有多热。

spark.en: A single spark from a train set the dry grass on fire.
spark.zh: 火车上的一个火星点燃了干草。

spark.en: The court's decision could spark a wider debate about water rights.
spark.zh: 法院的裁决可能引发一场关于水权的更广泛讨论。

vessel.en: The liquid is heated in a sealed vessel to keep it pure.
vessel.zh: 液体在密封容器中加热,以保持纯净。

vessel.en: Fishing vessels from several countries operate in these waters.
vessel.zh: 来自几个国家的渔船在这片海域作业。

vessel.en: Regular exercise helps to keep the blood vessels healthy.
vessel.zh: 经常锻炼有助于保持血管健康。

wax.en: Bees make wax to build the small cells in their hives.
wax.zh: 蜜蜂分泌蜡来建造蜂巢里的小巢室。

cement.en: Producing cement releases a large amount of carbon dioxide into the air.
cement.zh: 生产水泥向空气中释放大量二氧化碳。

explode.en: A build-up of gas may cause old mines to explode.
explode.zh: 气体积聚可能导致旧矿井爆炸。

astronomy.en: Ancient farmers used astronomy to work out when to plant their crops.
astronomy.zh: 古代农民利用天文学确定何时播种。

astronomer.en: The astronomer spent years recording the movement of the planets.
astronomer.zh: 这位天文学家花了多年时间记录行星的运动。

universe.en: Scientists estimate that the universe is almost fourteen billion years old.
universe.zh: 科学家估计宇宙的年龄约为一百四十亿年。

cosmos.en: Early philosophers believed that the Earth was the centre of the cosmos.
cosmos.zh: 早期哲学家认为地球是宇宙的中心。

galaxy.en: Our galaxy contains billions of stars similar to the Sun.
galaxy.zh: 我们的星系包含数十亿颗与太阳相似的恒星。

the-milky-way.en: The Milky Way can be seen clearly from areas with no city lights.
the-milky-way.zh: 在没有城市灯光的地区,银河系清晰可见。

solar-system.en: Jupiter is the largest planet in the solar system.
solar-system.zh: 木星是太阳系中最大的行星。

planet.en: Scientists have found thousands of planets orbiting other stars.
planet.zh: 科学家已经发现了数千颗围绕其他恒星运行的行星。

satellite.en: The satellite sends back detailed images of the Earth's surface.
satellite.zh: 这颗卫星传回地球表面的详细图像。

orbit.en: The new telescope was placed in orbit high above the Earth.
orbit.zh: 新望远镜被送入地球上空的高轨道。

orbit.en: The Earth takes about 365 days to orbit the Sun.
orbit.zh: 地球绕太阳运行一周大约需要 365 天。

comet.en: A bright comet was recorded by Chinese astronomers more than two thousand years ago.
comet.zh: 中国天文学家在两千多年前记录了一颗明亮的彗星。

asteroid.en: Many scientists think an asteroid helped to wipe out the dinosaurs.
asteroid.zh: 许多科学家认为小行星促成了恐龙的灭绝。

meteor.en: A meteor burns up as it enters the atmosphere at high speed.
meteor.zh: 流星高速进入大气层时会燃烧殆尽。

meteorite.en: The meteorite that landed in the desert contained small amounts of rare metals.
meteorite.zh: 落在沙漠中的陨石含有少量稀有金属。

constellation.en: Sailors used the constellation in the northern sky to find their way.
constellation.zh: 水手利用北方天空中的星座辨别方向。

nebula.en: New stars are formed in a nebula, a huge cloud of gas and dust.
nebula.zh: 新恒星在星云中形成,星云是由气体和尘埃组成的巨大云团。

black-hole.en: Nothing can escape from a black hole, not even light.
black-hole.zh: 任何东西都无法逃脱黑洞,甚至光也不行。

supernova.en: A supernova occurs when a very large star explodes at the end of its life.
supernova.zh: 当一颗非常大的恒星在生命末期爆炸时,就形成了超新星。

light-year.en: The nearest star to the Sun is just over four light-years away.
light-year.zh: 距太阳最近的恒星只有四光年多。

gravity.en: Gravity keeps the planets moving in their paths around the Sun.
gravity.zh: 重力使行星沿轨道绕太阳运行。

gravitational.en: The Moon's gravitational pull is the main cause of the tides.
gravitational.zh: 月球的引力是潮汐的主要成因。

telescope.en: With his telescope, Galileo discovered four moons around Jupiter.
telescope.zh: 伽利略用望远镜发现了木星的四颗卫星。

observatory.en: The new observatory was built on a high mountain with clear skies.
observatory.zh: 新天文台建在一座晴空万里的高山上。

spacecraft.en: The spacecraft travelled for seven years before reaching the planet.
spacecraft.zh: 这艘航天器飞行了七年才到达这颗行星。

probe.en: The space probe sent back the first close-up pictures of the planet.
probe.zh: 这个太空探测器传回了这颗行星的第一批近距离照片。

probe.en: Researchers used sound waves to probe the structure of the ocean floor.
probe.zh: 研究者用声波探查海底的结构。

astronaut.en: Living in space causes an astronaut's bones and muscles to weaken.
astronaut.zh: 在太空生活使宇航员的骨骼和肌肉变弱。

space-station.en: Scientists on the space station carry out experiments in very low gravity.
space-station.zh: 空间站上的科学家在极低重力下进行实验。

lunar.en: Lunar rocks brought back to Earth have helped scientists understand its history.
lunar.zh: 带回地球的月球岩石帮助科学家了解它的历史。

solar.en: Solar energy now provides power to many remote villages.
solar.zh: 太阳能现在为许多偏远村庄提供电力。

eclipse.en: Early people were often frightened by a sudden eclipse of the Sun.
eclipse.zh: 早期的人们常常被突如其来的日食吓坏。

mars.en: Water once flowed across the surface of Mars, according to recent studies.
mars.zh: 最近的研究表明,火星表面曾有水流动。

jupiter.en: Jupiter has a huge storm that has lasted for hundreds of years.
jupiter.zh: 木星上有一场持续了数百年的巨大风暴。

venus.en: Thick clouds trap heat on Venus, making it the hottest planet.
venus.zh: 厚厚的云层把热量困在金星上,使它成为最热的行星。

astronomical.en: The Mayans kept detailed astronomical records of the movements of the stars.
astronomical.zh: 玛雅人保留了详细的恒星运行天文记录。

astronomical.en: The cost of the project rose to an astronomical figure.
astronomical.zh: 这个项目的费用升到了天文数字。

celestial.en: Ancient navigators used celestial objects such as stars to find their position.
celestial.zh: 古代航海者利用恒星等天体确定自己的位置。

cosmic.en: Cosmic rays from deep space constantly strike the Earth's atmosphere.
cosmic.zh: 来自深空的宇宙射线不断撞击地球大气层。

cosmology.en: Modern cosmology tries to explain how the universe began.
cosmology.zh: 现代宇宙学试图解释宇宙是如何起源的。

astrophysics.en: She studied astrophysics in order to understand how stars are formed.
astrophysics.zh: 她学习天体物理学,以了解恒星是如何形成的。

astrology.en: Unlike astronomy, astrology has no scientific basis at all.
astrology.zh: 与天文学不同,占星术完全没有科学依据。

pseudoscience.en: Scientists dismissed the claims about crystal healing as pseudoscience.
pseudoscience.zh: 科学家把水晶疗法的说法斥为伪科学。

quasar.en: A quasar can shine far more brightly than an entire galaxy.
quasar.zh: 类星体的亮度可能远远超过整个星系。

dwarf.en: The Sun will eventually become a small white dwarf.
dwarf.zh: 太阳最终将变成一颗小白矮星。

dwarf.en: Dwarf trees grow near the top of the mountain, where it is colder.
dwarf.zh: 矮小的树生长在接近山顶、气温更低的地方。

corona.en: The Sun's corona can be seen clearly during a total eclipse.
corona.zh: 日全食时可以清楚地看到太阳的日冕。

interstellar.en: Interstellar travel is still far beyond our present technology.
interstellar.zh: 星际旅行仍然远远超出我们目前的技术水平。

interplanetary.en: Interplanetary missions take years of planning and huge amounts of money.
interplanetary.zh: 行星际任务需要多年规划和巨额资金。

intergalactic.en: Intergalactic distances are so huge that they are hard to imagine.
intergalactic.zh: 星系际距离如此巨大,很难想象。

revolve.en: The planets revolve around the Sun in almost circular paths.
revolve.zh: 行星以近乎圆形的轨道绕太阳公转。

spaceship.en: Living on a spaceship for years would be a great challenge for humans.
spaceship.zh: 在宇宙飞船上生活多年对人类来说是巨大的挑战。

mercury.en: Mercury is the smallest planet and the one closest to the Sun.
mercury.zh: 水星是最小的行星,也是离太阳最近的行星。

saturn.en: Saturn is famous for the bright rings of ice and rock around it.
saturn.zh: 土星以环绕它的明亮冰岩环闻名。

uranus.en: Uranus was first identified as a planet by William Herschel in 1781.
uranus.zh: 1781 年,威廉·赫歇尔首次确认天王星是一颗行星。

neptune.en: Neptune takes about 165 Earth years to travel around the Sun.
neptune.zh: 海王星绕太阳运行一周大约需要 165 个地球年。

pluto.en: Pluto is no longer classed as a full planet by most astronomers.
pluto.zh: 大多数天文学家不再把冥王星归为完整的行星。

meteor-shower.en: A meteor shower happens when the Earth passes through a trail of dust.
meteor-shower.zh: 地球穿过尘埃带时,就会出现流星雨。

alien.en: Alien plants brought in by ships can quickly replace local species.
alien.zh: 船只带来的外来植物可能迅速取代本地物种。

alien.en: Films about aliens reflect people's interest in life on other planets.
alien.zh: 有关外星人的电影反映出人们对其他星球生命的兴趣。

bang.en: Most scientists think the universe began with a big bang.
bang.zh: 大多数科学家认为宇宙始于一场大爆炸。

rotation.en: The rotation of the Earth is the reason why we have day and night.
rotation.zh: 地球的自转是昼夜交替的原因。

rotation.en: Crop rotation helps to keep the soil rich in nutrients.
rotation.zh: 作物轮作有助于保持土壤养分充足。

rotate.en: The Moon rotates once in the time it takes to orbit the Earth.
rotate.zh: 月球自转一周的时间与绕地球一周的时间相同。

trajectory.en: Scientists can calculate the exact trajectory of the asteroid.
trajectory.zh: 科学家能计算出这颗小行星的准确轨迹。

mathematics.en: Ancient Babylonians used advanced mathematics to predict the movement of planets.
mathematics.zh: 古巴比伦人运用高等数学预测行星的运动。

arithmetic.en: Children first learn basic arithmetic by counting objects with their fingers.
arithmetic.zh: 孩子们最初通过掰手指数东西来学习基本算术。

geometry.en: Egyptian builders used geometry to plan the shape of the pyramids.
geometry.zh: 埃及建造者运用几何规划金字塔的形状。

calculus.en: Newton and Leibniz developed calculus at about the same time.
calculus.zh: 牛顿和莱布尼茨几乎同时创立了微积分。

equation.en: The equation allows us to calculate the energy released by the reaction.
equation.zh: 这个方程让我们能够计算反应释放的能量。

probability.en: The probability of a major earthquake in the next decade is quite high.
probability.zh: 未来十年发生大地震的概率相当高。

statistician.en: A statistician checked the data to make sure that the results were reliable.
statistician.zh: 一位统计学家检查了数据,确保结果可靠。

calculate.en: Early astronomers were able to calculate the size of the Earth.
calculate.zh: 早期的天文学家能够计算出地球的大小。

calculator.en: Pocket calculators became cheap and widely available in the 1970s.
calculator.zh: 袖珍计算器在 20 世纪 70 年代变得便宜且普及。

abacus.en: Traders in ancient China used an abacus to keep their accounts.
abacus.zh: 古代中国的商人用算盘记账。

subtract.en: To find the difference, subtract the smaller number from the larger one.
subtract.zh: 要求差值,就用较大的数减去较小的数。

multiply.en: To find the area, multiply the length of the field by its width.
multiply.zh: 要求面积,就用田地的长度乘以宽度。

multiply.en: Bacteria can multiply very quickly in warm food.
multiply.zh: 细菌在温热的食物中能很快成倍增加。

divide.en: Divide the total distance by the time to calculate the average speed.
divide.zh: 用总距离除以时间可以算出平均速度。

divide.en: The mountains divide the country into two very different regions.
divide.zh: 山脉把这个国家分成两个截然不同的地区。

decimal.en: The answer should be given to two decimal places.

digit.en: Telephone numbers in the country now have eleven digits.
digit.zh: 该国的电话号码现在有十一位数字。

numeral.en: Roman numerals are still used on some clocks and old buildings.
numeral.zh: 罗马数字仍用于一些时钟和老建筑上。

even-number.en: Any even number can be divided by two without a remainder.
even-number.zh: 任何偶数都能被二整除。

odd-number.en: An odd number cannot be divided into two equal whole numbers.
odd-number.zh: 奇数不能被分成两个相等的整数。

constant.en: The speed of light in a vacuum is a physical constant.
constant.zh: 真空中的光速是一个物理常数。

constant.en: The cave stays at a constant temperature throughout the entire year.
constant.zh: 这个洞穴全年保持恒定的温度。

function.en: Each function in the program performs one simple mathematical task.
function.zh: 程序中的每个函数执行一项简单的数学任务。

function.en: The main function of the roots is to absorb water from the soil.
function.zh: 根的主要功能是从土壤中吸收水分。

symmetry.en: Most animals have a natural symmetry in the shape of their bodies.
symmetry.zh: 大多数动物的身体形状具有天然的对称性。

parallel.en: The two rivers run parallel to each other for almost fifty kilometres.
parallel.zh: 这两条河平行流淌了近五十公里。

parallel.en: There are clear parallels between the fall of Rome and modern events.
parallel.zh: 罗马的衰落与现代事件之间有明显的相似之处。

intersect.en: The two roads intersect near the centre of the ancient town.
intersect.zh: 这两条路在古镇中心附近相交。

vertical.en: The vertical axis of the graph shows the average temperature each month.
vertical.zh: 图表的纵轴显示每月的平均气温。

horizontal.en: The rock layers are horizontal, showing that they have not been disturbed.
horizontal.zh: 岩层是水平的,说明它们没有受到扰动。

plane.en: Two lines on the same flat plane either cross or run side by side.
plane.zh: 同一平面上的两条线要么相交,要么平行。

plane.en: Thousands of commercial planes cross the Atlantic every day.
plane.zh: 每天有数千架商用飞机飞越大西洋。

segment.en: The line segment connecting the two points is three centimetres long.
segment.zh: 连接两点的线段长三厘米。

segment.en: Older people form a growing segment of the market for holidays.
segment.zh: 老年人在度假市场中所占的部分越来越大。

angle.en: The light strikes the surface of the water at a narrow angle.
angle.zh: 光线以很小的角度照射到水面。

obtuse.en: An obtuse angle measures more than ninety degrees.

diameter.en: The trunk of the old tree measures more than three metres in diameter.
diameter.zh: 这棵老树的树干直径超过三米。

radius.en: Bears may hunt within a radius of fifty kilometres from their home.
radius.zh: 熊可能在距家半径五十公里的范围内捕猎。

circumference.en: An ancient Greek scholar made an early estimate of the circumference of the Earth.
circumference.zh: 一位古希腊学者很早就估算出了地球的周长。

rectangle.en: The Roman town was laid out in the shape of a rectangle.
rectangle.zh: 这座罗马城镇布局呈长方形。

parallelogram.en: A parallelogram has two pairs of sides of equal length.
parallelogram.zh: 平行四边形有两组等长的边。

trapezoid.en: The field was shaped like a trapezoid, with one long side beside the river.
trapezoid.zh: 这块田呈梯形,有一条长边靠着河。

polygon.en: A polygon is a flat shape with three or more straight sides.
polygon.zh: 多边形是有三条或更多直边的平面图形。

hexagonal.en: Bees build hexagonal cells because this shape uses the least wax.
hexagonal.zh: 蜜蜂建造六边形的巢室,因为这种形状用蜡最少。

octagonal.en: The old tower has an unusual octagonal base made of local stone.
octagonal.zh: 这座古塔有一个不寻常的八边形基座,由当地石料砌成。

semicircle.en: The seats in the ancient theatre were arranged in a semicircle.
semicircle.zh: 古代剧场的座位排成半圆形。

ellipse.en: Each planet moves around the Sun in the shape of an ellipse.
ellipse.zh: 每颗行星都沿椭圆轨迹绕太阳运行。

cube.en: Salt crystals naturally form in the shape of a tiny cube.
cube.zh: 盐的晶体天然呈微小的立方体。

sphere.en: The Earth is not a perfect sphere but is slightly flat at the poles.
sphere.zh: 地球不是完美的球体,两极略扁。

sphere.en: Women were largely excluded from the political sphere at that time.
sphere.zh: 当时女性基本被排除在政治领域之外。

cylinder.en: The grain was stored in a tall metal cylinder beside the farm.
cylinder.zh: 谷物储存在农场旁一个高大的金属圆柱体中。

cone.en: Volcanoes often take the shape of a cone as lava builds up.
cone.zh: 随着熔岩堆积,火山常常形成圆锥形。

spiral.en: The shell grows in a spiral as the animal inside gets bigger.
spiral.zh: 随着里面的动物长大,贝壳呈螺旋状生长。

crescent.en: Viewed from Earth, the Moon appears as a thin crescent at this time.
crescent.zh: 从地球上看,此时的月亮呈细细的新月形。

matrix.en: The data was arranged in a matrix of rows and columns.
matrix.zh: 数据被排列成由行和列组成的矩阵。

minus.en: Temperatures at the research station can fall to minus sixty degrees.
minus.zh: 研究站的气温可能降到零下六十度。

linear.en: The results show a linear relationship between age and body weight.
linear.zh: 结果显示年龄与体重之间存在线性关系。

spatial.en: Playing with building blocks helps children to develop spatial skills.
spatial.zh: 玩积木有助于儿童发展空间能力。

triangle.en: Early builders knew that the triangle is a very strong shape.
triangle.zh: 早期的建造者知道三角形是非常坚固的形状。

regression.en: Researchers used regression to study the link between income and health.
regression.zh: 研究者使用回归方法研究收入与健康之间的关系。

vector.en: A vector shows both the size and the direction of a force.
vector.zh: 向量同时表示力的大小和方向。

coefficient.en: A high coefficient shows that the two variables are closely related.
coefficient.zh: 系数高表明这两个变量密切相关。

infinite.en: Some philosophers believed that the universe was infinite in size.
infinite.zh: 一些哲学家认为宇宙的大小是无限的。

notation.en: Modern mathematical notation makes calculations far easier than the older systems.
notation.zh: 现代数学符号让计算比旧系统简单得多。

infinity.en: Ancient mathematicians struggled with the idea of infinity.
infinity.zh: 古代数学家曾苦苦思索无穷大的概念。

subset.en: The researchers studied a small subset of the full data.
subset.zh: 研究者研究了全部数据中的一小部分子集。

computation.en: Early computers could perform only a few simple computations each second.
computation.zh: 早期计算机每秒只能完成几次简单的计算。

algebra.en: Algebra was developed further by Arab scholars during the Middle Ages.
algebra.zh: 中世纪时,阿拉伯学者进一步发展了代数。

non-linear.en: Population growth often follows a non-linear pattern over long periods.
non-linear.zh: 长期来看,人口增长往往呈非线性模式。

congruent.en: Two triangles are congruent if they have exactly the same shape and size.
congruent.zh: 两个三角形如果形状和大小完全相同,就是全等的。

axiom.en: Euclid began his work on geometry with a small number of axioms.
axiom.zh: 欧几里得的几何学著作从少数几条公理开始。

factorial.en: The factorial of five is the product of all whole numbers up to five.
factorial.zh: 五的阶乘是从一到五所有整数的乘积。

compute.en: The machine could compute the positions of the planets accurately.
compute.zh: 这台机器能准确计算行星的位置。
